$schema_note: Constructed motion-source descriptor for the corpus's `anny-tpose-sweep` subset per RFD 2203. Satisfies CLAUDE.md's generated-synthetic condition 3 for the corpus as a whole: the corpus must carry at least one constructed-pose subset before any training run consumes it. The renderer reads this file to know which base rest poses to render, and how to procedurally build parameterised variations from them.

motion_source.name: anny-tpose-sweep
motion_source.description: Rest poses shipped with ANNY under `data/mpfb2/poses/*/t-pose.json` plus deterministic parameterised variations. All pose joint rotations derive from JSON files or from a documented parameter sweep; no sampling from a generative model.

base_rest_poses.notes: T-pose against CMU-MB rig naming. Base for retargeted-motion variations.
T-pose against MPFB2 default FK rig.

procedural_variations.description: Deterministic pose construction on top of the T-pose per axis. `renderer` iterates these ranges at the specified stride and produces one posed frame per (base_rest_pose, variation) combination. All rotations are named joint targets, no sampling, so the outputs are `constructed` per CLAUDE.md. Every range fits inside the anatomy ROM envelope at `sources/anatomy-rom-envelope.json` (NASA RP-1024 Vol.I, PD verified); `check_corpus_manifest.py --envelope-check` asserts this and a deliberately hyperextended range fails.
procedural_variations.combinations: cartesian product of the sweeps per base_rest_pose; deterministic enumeration; no randomness
procedural_variations.expected_pose_count_notes: 7 arm-L * 7 arm-R * 5 hip * 4 knee-L * 4 knee-R * 5 spine * 5 head-yaw * 3 head-pitch = 8820 per base if all combined; smaller in practice because most combinations are symmetric or anatomically extreme. The renderer subsamples to a per-subset target count named in the shard manifest's sampler_config.

renderer_hook.expected_row_shape: RFD 2203 hybrid row unchanged; anny_posed_vertices is computed by anny.Anny(rig='soma', topology=TopologyConfig(base_mesh='makehuman', remove_unattached_vertices=False))(pose_parameters=constructed_from_base_and_sweep, ...); soma_pose is the per-frame (77, 3) rotvec array the sweep constructed

provenance.condition_1_generator: n/a (no generator; deterministic parameter sweep from CC0 rest poses)
provenance.condition_2_stored_separately: this file names motion_source=anny-tpose-sweep; the shard manifest's motion_source field records it, distinct from any kimodo subset
provenance.condition_3_not_sole_distribution: this subset's existence is what satisfies condition 3 for the corpus. Without at least one anny-tpose-sweep (or equivalent constructed-pose) subset in the corpus, any Kimodo-only training run violates CLAUDE.md's generated-synthetic condition 3
provenance.condition_4_evaluation_on_real_or_constr: blinded holdout coco_person_commercial_val2017 remains the evaluation set per CLAUDE.md; this subset is training-only
provenance.rendering_class: constructed synthetic; deterministic sweep of documented joint ranges applied to CC0 rest poses; same seed reproduces the corpus
